trigger: A frozen two-component control plus the same learned adviser earned -1,+8,+14 on three historical disjoint training-held panels. Register this technical extension and its comparison before observing the designated score from the new single-incumbent near-tie run. The new proof is a fresh autonomous raw solve, not a post-hoc manual three-model submission.
implementation: When a declared preference task has sufficient numeric allowance, first autonomously search for and freeze a deliverable. A multi-model incumbent may now recruit at most one analogue voter. Resolve each actually elected component's own verified representation and rank eligible sources only by that component's measured PRIMARY training metric; break ties using executable parameters. Faced with an unsupported source, no measured probabilities or insufficient work allowance, retain the incumbent. The inner ballot remains label-free apart from training. Component count, weight, configuration, encoder names and dataset are never passed through the solve command.
policy: Set the same cap 22 and time 1800 for both arms, use all installed modular encoders, no language model or method hint. The already shipped controller is the control. In the revised controller, reserve the existing maximum of six countable fits; the 16-fit core may autonomously select any feasible model or group. Use the same prespecified primary nomination/near-tie rule, independent matched confirmation and safe publication as the single-incumbent implementation. Only a confirmed challenger may join or replace a model. Flatten and publish the true effective weights for the entire selected model. Keep both election receipts.
evaluation: Run and reload both arms independently. Report every attempt, selected constituent and whether the initial ensemble really occurred. Compare sealed 940 predictions once after both are locked, against each other and the already measured ten/sixteen-fit models. Big increases in training or numbers of models alone cannot certify a better method. This is the last designated validation read in this series; further development uses training folds. Official test and H2 remain closed. No API.
meaning: This is a development comparison on two known public tasks' infrastructure. A real raw run still accepting or rejecting advice autonomously must be evidenced from its own actions; the prior three-fold computation cannot prove end-to-end operation.
